name: Scorning And Mocking
overview: Scripture reveals that scorning and mocking are serious offenses that provoke God's displeasure, as seen in the examples of Sarah witnessing Hagar's son mocking (Genesis 21:9) and the children at Bethel mocking the prophet (2 Kings 2:23). The call in 2 Chronicles 30 emphasizes turning away from such rebellious attitudes, urging the children of Israel to yield to the Lord and avoid the stiff-necked pride that leads to desolation (2 Chronicles 30:6-9). These verses highlight the danger and folly of mockery, contrasting it with the merciful invitation to repentance and reverence toward God.
